short.q: How should you answer a question that starts with 'Wann'?
short.model: Give a time or date only, a short phrase copied or adapted from the text, e.g. 'im Mai'.
points: short phrase, no extra wrong information

short.q: The text says 'Sie fährt mit dem Rad, obwohl der Bus vor ihrer Tür hält.' Why must you be careful with 'obwohl'?
short.model: It shows a contrast: the bus is available but she does not use it, so the bus is a distractor.
points: bus is a distractor / she cycles

short.q: Split 'die Kinderbetreuung' to guess the meaning.
short.model: Kinder (children) + Betreuung (care) = childcare, and it is feminine because Betreuung is.

short.q: What is the difference between 'Wie viel' and 'Wie viele'?
short.model: Wie viel is how much (uncountable, e.g. money); wie viele is how many (countable plural).

short.q: List two things to check in a gap-fill task apart from the meaning.
short.model: Gender and case of the article/adjective, and the verb ending (agreement with the subject).
